# Imen Bouzouita — Digital Product, UX & CRO Consultant, Berlin

> I help e-commerce, wellness, and SaaS brands turn browsers into buyers with research-backed UX audits and interfaces people actually want to use.

Digital Product · UX · CRO Consultant — Berlin. I'm a UX, CRO, and digital strategy consultant based in Berlin. I work with e-commerce, wellness, and SaaS brands that know their product is strong but suspect their website is leaving money on the table. My job is to find out where and fix it — through conversion audits, UX redesigns, landing page builds, and structured A/B testing.

## What I Do

- [UX/CRO and SEO Audits](https://imenbouzouita.com/#work-do): 15–30 prioritized fixes. I tell you exactly what's costing you conversions — and how to fix it.
- [Landing Page Redesign](https://imenbouzouita.com/#work-do): From wireframe to live page in a week. Built to convert, not just to look nice.
- [Full Website & Shop Builds](https://imenbouzouita.com/#work-do): Webflow, Shopify, Framer, WordPress. Structure, design, and build — end to end.
- [Neuroscience-Backed Insights](https://imenbouzouita.com/#work-do): Worked at the Deloitte Neuroscience Institute. I design with how people actually think, not just how they say they behave.

## Case Studies

- [Sacred Metrics](https://imenbouzouita.com/work/sacred-metrics/): Closing the conversion gap for a 20-year wellness brand — A 20-year-old wellness brand in Ubud, Bali with strong organic traffic, genuine guest loyalty, and a domain rating of 62 backed by 13.5K backlinks. The brief: modernise the digital experience, close the gap between offline reputation and online conversion, and assess AI search readiness.
- [The Collective](https://imenbouzouita.com/work/the-collective/): From Directory to Community Platform — A decade-old wellness directory in Bali with 885 referring domains, Wikipedia citations on its cultural content, and a position in 165 Google AI Overviews — operating within a three-property ecosystem that included a physical yoga studio and an annual wellness festival under the same ownership. The site had significant domain authority and editorial assets, but no defined strategic role within the ecosystem. The brief: assess the site's current state, define a strategic direction for the platform, and deliver a conversion-ready roadmap that connects it to the broader ecosystem.
- [Prima Materia](https://imenbouzouita.com/work/prima-materia/): The Practitioner's Site — Applying conversion thinking to my own coaching practice.
- [NeuroBoost UX](https://imenbouzouita.com/work/neuroboost-ux/): Using gaze data to close the gap between what users say they see and what they actually attend to — A product team had a conversion problem that standard usability testing couldn't explain. Users self-reported noticing trust signals — badges, guarantees, social proof — but the data told a different story. The brief: go beyond stated preference and measure attention itself.
- [Conversion Engine](https://imenbouzouita.com/work/conversion-engine/): Optimising checkout, product pages, and launch strategy from inside the team — A direct-to-consumer brand with healthy traffic but underperforming conversion. As shop manager and developer, I owned the full e-commerce operation — from product launches and shop optimisation to A/B testing and checkout improvements.
- [Resonance Tunes](https://imenbouzouita.com/work/resonance-tunes/): Conscious Tech, Grounded Design — Designing and building the digital identity for an ethical-AI wellness platform from scratch.

## About

- [About](https://imenbouzouita.com/#about): I've spent 10+ years moving between corporate innovation and independent work. At Deloitte, Siemens, and BMW I learned how large organisations approach product, research, and scale. On my own, I learned how to ship fast, prioritise ruthlessly, and make every recommendation something a small team can actually implement. I bring both.
